fields.DESCRIPTION: The Blush Boho Fringe Tote is a statement piece for free spirits and style lovers. Crafted with soft cotton fabric in a soothing blush pink and ivory palette, it features intricate woven patterns, playful fringes, and textured detailing that give it a chic bohemian vibe. Spacious and sturdy, this tote is perfect for casual outings, shopping trips, or beach days, while adding a touch of artisanal elegance to your everyday look.
